response.rationale: Waktu is the ordinary general term for time in Indonesian, while masa is a common general-time term in Malaysian Malay. The contrast is useful, though both forms have additional contextual uses.
response.risk_rationale: Masa in Indonesian is also common in expressions referring to a period or era, so learners may encounter it outside this general-time contrast.
